title.narrative: Protection and Promotion of Boat Race- the Most Popular Water Sports in Bangladesh.

description.narrative: The project addresses the decline of Boat Racing, once of the most popular and the most popular water sports in Bangladesh. Climate change, environmental shifts have led to the drying of water bodies, threatening this cherished water sport. Despite the rising popularity of mainstream sports like cricket and football, Boat Racing persists, particularly during the rainy season. This project strives to document resilient communities of men engaged in Boat Racing, preserving their cultural legacy. Through visual and written records, the initiative seeks to raise awareness about the sport's significance, offering a glimpse into a vanishing tradition, and fostering community empowerment amidst changing environmental dynamics
